detail.rawHtml:
Job highlights
  • . Proficiency with ASO tools,including Google Play Console and other external tools. Ability to work within a team and independently
  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience with ASO in a game / app with million+ installs. .
Job match score
Early Applicant
Keyskills
Location
Work Experience

Job description

    Be in charge of ASO of various apps and games.

    • Analyze the current state of ASO and define a strategy to maximize organic user acquisition.

    • Execute the ASO strategy in multiple languages working with different teams - keywords, description, title, screenshots, etc.

    • Optimize conversion rate on the store listing page with experiments and try to maximize the same.

    • Monitor and track rankings and conversion rates using ASO tools.

    • Always be on the lookout to increase downloads with improvements and new ideas.

    • Be up to date with the latest ASO tips, tricks, hacks and news.

    • Perform keyword research for Apps to optimize existing listing, uncover new opportunities, and expand the keyword set.

    • Optimizing Apps on both Play Store and App Store and improving rankings for app keywords both on Play Store and App Store.

    • Improve App organic traffic and Analyze click to install and uninstall rate for the apps.


Key Requirements
    • Minimum 2-4 years of experience with ASO in a game/app with million+ installs.

    • Excellent analytical and reporting skills.

    • Enthusiasm and energy to fire up internal teams

    • Great communication skills

    • Creative and original thinking

    • Proficiency with ASO tools, including Google Play Console and other external tools.

    • Ability to work within a team and independently
